normalized.result: Yes, this boundary feels right. Requiring a title makes sense — it's what keeps the bookmark recognizable, so refusing to save with it blank (and keeping the editor open without touching the saved card) is the right call. And letting the description be optional is fine too; after I gave it the title "Octopus intelligence" and left the description empty, it saved cleanly. That's a sensible line to draw. Good to move on.
